abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze the methods, feasibility, efficiency, and fertility outcomes of fertility-sparing treatment for patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). METHODS: Clinical data of patients diagnosed with PSTT between April 1998 and April 2020 from Peking Union Medical College Hospital (PUMCH) were retrospectively collected. The clinical features, treatment, and outcomes of patients received fertility-sparing treatment were analyzed and compared with patients suffered hysterectomy. RESULTS: In total, 126 patients were included in the study and 29 of them received fertility-sparing treatment. Besides significantly younger age and lower proportion of antecedent term delivery were seen in fertility-sparing group than hysterectomy group, no significant differences were observed in stage, serum β-hCG level, or interval from antecedent pregnancy between the two groups. Conservative surgery was selected individualized and none of them suffered salvage hysterectomy. Patients with clinical or pathological high-risk factors received adjuvant chemotherapy, yet the fertility-sparing treatment did not significantly lengthen chemotherapy duration. All patients in fertility-sparing group achieved complete remission without relapse after 36 to 176 months of follow-up and had sixteen healthy term delivery more than one year after the treatment. CONCLUSIONS: Fertility-sparing treatment for PSTT can be considered for young patients with localized uterine lesions who strongly desire to preserve their fertility potential. With individualized conservative surgery and selected adjuvant chemotherapy, fertility-sparing treatment will not influence the risk of relapse or overall survival and patients will achieve favorable pregnancy and live birth outcomes.
abstract_ja: 目的：胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）患者に対する妊孕性温存治療の方法、実行可能性、有効性、および妊孕性転帰を解析する。方法：1998年4月から2020年4月の間に北京協和医院（PUMCH）でPSTTと診断された患者の臨床データを後方視的に収集した。妊孕性温存治療を受けた患者の臨床的特徴、治療、転帰を解析し、子宮摘出術を受けた患者と比較した。結果：合計126例が対象となり、そのうち29例が妊孕性温存治療を受けた。妊孕性温存治療群は子宮摘出術群と比べて有意に若年であり、直前の正期産の割合が低かったが、病期、血清β-hCG値、直前の妊娠からの期間に両群間で有意な差は認められなかった。保存的手術は個別に選択され、救済的子宮摘出術を要した患者はいなかった。臨床的または病理学的に高リスクの因子を有する患者には補助化学療法が行われたが、妊孕性温存治療によって化学療法期間が有意に延長することはなかった。妊孕性温存治療群の全患者が完全寛解を達成し、36〜176か月の追跡期間において再発は認められず、治療後1年以上を経て16件の健康な正期産が得られた。結論：局所的な子宮病変を有し、妊孕性の温存を強く希望する若年患者には、PSTTに対する妊孕性温存治療を考慮できる。個別化された保存的手術と選択的な補助化学療法により、妊孕性温存治療は再発リスクや全生存期間に影響せず、患者は良好な妊娠および生児出産の転帰を得ることができる。
